_doc.backend: Which subject to run for PoC generation. 'openhands' = OpenHands + a base model. 'deepseek_harness' = host-native DeepSeek Harness headless backend for ARVO and local samples.
_doc.model: Model the subject generates with. OpenHands/deepseek form, e.g. 'deepseek/deepseek-chat'; DeepSeek Harness form, e.g. 'deepseek-v4-flash'.
_doc.base_url: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL, e.g. 'https://example.com/v1'. When set, OpenHands forces LiteLLM's OpenAI protocol adapter even for Claude-named models.
_doc.api_key_env: Optional environment or repo config.txt variable containing the API key. Never put the secret itself in this JSON. Defaults by model family.
_doc.results_namespace: Required model-specific directory name under poc_results/. This prevents one model run from overwriting another, for example 'deepseek-v4-flash' or 'gpt-5.4-mini'.
_doc.max_iter: Iteration cap per episode. The initial prompt requires a final analysis.json artifact; at the cap the harness permits one tool-free format-only final turn.
_doc.max_attempts: Re-run an episode up to this many times if it dies before a normal endpoint and therefore produces no final analysis artifact.
_doc.openhands_repo: Complete OpenHands checkout to execute. Leave empty only when external/OpenHands itself is a complete checkout.
_doc.parallel: Max samples generated concurrently (1-6). Each holds one ARVO Docker workspace, so this is the Docker concurrency budget.
_doc.tmp_root: Optional disk-backed temp root exported as TMPDIR to generation subprocesses. Use this instead of /tmp for parallel ARVO runs.
_doc.server: CyberGym submission server URL (start it with start_server.sh; PoC bytes land under server/logs/<poc_id>/poc.bin).
_doc.difficulty: CyberGym task difficulty level (level1 = issue description + crash only, cybergym-style).
_doc.run_reachability_after_generation: When true, rerun_model_batches.py evaluates deduplicated submitted PoCs immediately after each generation run and writes reachability_eval.json in the sample result directory.
_doc.reachability_max_hits_per_event: Maximum GDB hits retained for each reachability checkpoint.
_doc.allow_tool_network: Debug only. For deepseek_harness, false injects a hard network guard into subject-agent shell processes so they cannot download public PoCs; only the local validator is allowed.
_doc.dsh_src: For deepseek_harness, local DeepSeek Harness checkout. This third-party source is installed under external/deepseek-harness and is not tracked in this repository.
_doc.dsh_node_root: For deepseek_harness, Node runtime root containing bin/node.
_doc.dsh_home: For deepseek_harness, host-side DSH_HOME used for the deterministic headless profile and JSONL sessions.
_doc.dsh_scratch_root: For deepseek_harness, directory for temporary per-sample workspaces. Prefer disk-backed cache over /tmp because source trees can be large.
_doc.samples: Sample ids to generate PoCs for ('arvo_<id>' or bare '<id>'). Each writes poc_results/<results_namespace>/<sample_id>/ (checkpoint + manifest + analysis.json) for traceability. If run_reachability_after_generation is true, reachability_eval.json is written in the same sample directory before optional ARVO cleanup. ARVO Docker assets are retained unless cleanup_arvo_assets is explicitly enabled.
